question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

She was __overstrung __before her dance performance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Nervous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"overstrung"** means being extremely tense or agitated, often as a result of anxiety or stress. (अत्यधिक तनावग्रस्त)

 
 
• **Example: **She was overstrung before her dance performance, worrying about every minor detail.
 
 
 
• **"Nervous" **refers to feeling easily agitated or alarmed, typically due to anxiety or fear. (घबराया हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **He felt nervous before giving his speech in front of the large audience.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'overstrung' **is **'nervous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Nervous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cheerful **(प्रसन्न): Being noticeably happy and optimistic.

 
 
• **Example:** She was cheerful and full of energy at the party.
 
 
 
• **Calm **(शांत): Not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions.
 
 
• **Example: **He remained calm even in the face of chaos.
 
 
 
• **Placid **(शांत): Not easily upset or excited; peaceful.
 
 
• **Example:** The placid lake was a perfect spot for a quiet afternoon.
